Collective Secures $100 Million to Expand AI Financial Platform for Solo Businesses

30 Oct 2026, 08:32 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.prnewswire.com

Image: Collective — Creative Commons

Key takeawaysCollective, an artificial intelligence-native financial operating system designed for single-owner businesses, announced a $100 million funding round. The capital injection is intended to accelerate product development in banking and insurance, while scaling operations

Collective, an artificial intelligence-native financial operating system designed for single-owner businesses, announced a $100 million funding round. The capital injection is intended to accelerate product development in banking and insurance, while scaling operations for what the company describes as the "solopreneur" economy.

Funding Breakdown and Backing

The financing package consists of two primary components. It includes a $40 million Series B funding round led by General Catalyst, QED Investors, and Gradient Ventures, with additional participation from Intuit Ventures, FT Partners, and SemperVirens. Alongside the equity round, the company secured a $60 million growth facility from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund specifically earmarked to drive customer acquisition.

Collective provides a full-stack financial operating system tailored for "Businesses-of-One." The platform integrates multiple administrative functions—such as business entity formation, automated bookkeeping, expense categorization, invoicing, payroll processing, tax preparation, and integrated business and health insurance options—into a single system.

Market Context and Growth

The funding announcement arrives amid a broader expansion of solo-operated businesses in the United States, which has grown past 30 million entities. Citing recent industry data, the company notes that solo operators generating $1 million in annual revenue doubled between 2023 and 2025, while those earning $10 million tripled.

According to Collective, its annual recurring revenue (ARR) is growing at 120% year-over-year. The platform states that its tools have helped solo operators save an estimated $350 million in cumulative taxes, with higher-earning members reportedly saving up to $40,000 annually through structured setups like S-Corporations.

Practical Implications and What Readers Can Verify

For self-employed professionals and freelancers navigating administrative tasks, platforms like Collective represent an emerging category of automated back-office software.

  • What is Confirmed: Collective has raised $100 million total through a combination of a $40 million Series B and a $60 million growth facility. The company reports a 120% annual growth rate in ARR and claims $350 million in total tax savings for its user base.
  • What Remains Unknown: Specific details regarding the long-term timeline for upcoming banking and insurance product rollouts, as well as individual user eligibility criteria for maximum tax savings, were not exhaustively detailed in the announcement.
  • How to Verify: Readers can review the original announcement and learn more about the platform's services directly on the [Collective Official Website](https://www.collective.com/).
